query: Steps to take after my vehicle has been picked up by authorities.
reference_answer:
Towed Away Vehicle:
If your vehicle is towed away, contact the nearest Traffic Police station or the towing company to locate your vehicle. You will need to produce your vehicle's registration documents and pay any applicable fines or towing charges to retrieve your vehicle.
answer: After your vehicle is picked up by authorities, follow these steps: report the incident to your insurance company, check with local authorities for a pick-up notice, and contact your state's Secretary of State for a replacement title. [Document 1]
